title: Moderation Activity
description: The audit log replica in luvax_analytics.admin_actions: what administrators and the system did, and how fresh the replica is.

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfDay(created_at) AS time, action_type AS series, count() AS actions FROM luvax_analytics.admin_actions FINAL WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time

panels.title: Replication freshness
panels.description: Age of the newest replicated row, regardless of the time range. A quiet audit log is old by nature; compare with the ingestion lag alert for a stuck pipeline.

targets.rawSql: SELECT if(count() = 0, NULL, dateDiff('second', max(replicated_at), now())) AS seconds_since_last_replicated_row FROM luvax_analytics.admin_actions FINAL

panels.title: Actions by actor (top 10)
panels.description: A missing admin_id is shown as system: a system action, or an administrator whose account was deleted.

targets.rawSql: SELECT if(admin_id IS NULL, 'system', toString(admin_id)) AS actor, count() AS actions FROM luvax_analytics.admin_actions FINAL WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY actor ORDER BY actions DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT ifNull(target_entity_type, 'none') AS target_type, count() AS actions FROM luvax_analytics.admin_actions FINAL WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY target_type ORDER BY actions DESC

SELECT created_at AS time, action_type, if(admin_id IS NULL, 'system', toString(admin_id)) AS actor, ifNull(toString(target_user_id), '') AS target_user, ifNull(target_entity_type, '') AS target_type, ifNull(reason, '') AS reason, toString(id) AS id FROM luvax_analytics.admin_actions FINAL WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) ORDER BY created_at DESC, toString(id) DESC LIMIT 50
